facts.business: Sampark India Logistics Limited is an end-to-end logistics solution provider offering multi-modal transportation (road, rail, air), warehousing, transshipment, and last-mile delivery services primarily to OEMs and industrial customers across automotive, pharmaceuticals, consumer durables, and textiles sectors.
